bullets.title: META: JPMorgan upgrades to OW, raises PT to $820 on Muse AI Agent + Watermelon model
bullets.body: JPM's Doug Anmuth upgrades META from Neutral to Overweight, raising PT from $640 to $820 (23x 2028E GAAP EPS of $35.44). Muse AI agent hit #3 on US App Store on day 2 with usage 10x testing cohorts; Watermelon (next-gen model) shipping soon with a 1GW compute cluster in Ohio. Wells Fargo also upgraded to OW citing frontier model optionality. Street now sits at 72 buys, 7 holds, 0 sells. Key bear case: JPM models negative FCF of $65-70B in 2027-28 on $243-284B capex.

bullets.title: META Muse vs. competitors: OPCO skeptical on monetization, Hedgeye bullish signal
bullets.body: Oppenheimer remains Perform on META, arguing Muse needs ~115M paying subscribers (2x ChatGPT) to drive meaningful EPS upside, and only 8% of non-agent users trust META vs. Google. Jefferies/OPCO note META faces headwinds: consumers already use ChatGPT/Gemini and paid adoption likelihood is low. However, Hedgeye Risk Range maintains META as Bullish with buy level $591, sell level $675.

bullets.title: AAPL iPhone Duo foldable at $1,999 — Street view in-line to slightly positive; iPhone 18 Pro +$100
bullets.body: Apple's first foldable iPhone Duo at $1,999 (7.6" inner display, iOS fold-angle adaptation) impressed on design/execution; supply limited to 8-10M units. iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max priced $100 higher at $1,199/$1,299, below feared $200 hike — viewed positively. Jefferies reiterates Underperform flagging volume-over-margin strategy; MS bullish on 57% of iPhone base being >4 years old as upgrade catalyst. Low-end iPhone 18 delayed to spring seen as modest caution.

bullets.title: ORCL earnings tonight: 11% implied move; OCI growth and AI capex ROI are the key debates
bullets.body: ORCL reports after close with consensus at $1.74 EPS / $19.13B revenue. Jefferies notes ORCL is a material laggard vs IGV with short interest near multi-year highs; duration holders concerned about a potential CY27 equity raise. UBS sees risks priced in at mid-teens C'27 EPS multiple after -27% pullback since May; OCI growth guidance implies ~120% growth in FQ1/Aug. Key bear: high OpenAI exposure and uncertain AI capex ROIC.

bullets.title: ADBE earnings tonight: AI disruption + OpenAI ad ban compound existing headwinds
bullets.body: ADBE reports after close (consensus $6.08 EPS / $6.69B revenue). UBS flags multiple headwinds: AI disruption, sales cycle lengthening, leadership transition, and ~8% ARR organic growth guidance (cut from ~10%) due to AI pricing deflation. OpenAI is now barring competing AI image/audio product ads in ChatGPT, directly impacting ADBE. Stock remains -26% YTD despite 26% rally off lows.

bullets.title: NVDA: DOJ investigating $17B Groq licensing deal for potential antitrust circumvention
bullets.body: The DOJ is investigating whether Nvidia's $17B Groq licensing/acquihire deal was structured to circumvent antitrust review. Separately, Piper Sandler initiates NVDA at Overweight with a $300 PT. Hedgeye Risk Range keeps NVDA Bullish with buy/sell levels of $216/$231.

bullets.title: Piper Sandler initiates AI compute cluster OW: AVGO, AMD, ARM, NVDA, MRVL all overweight
bullets.body: Piper initiates coverage on 7 AI compute names; top picks are AVGO ($460 PT), NVDA ($300 PT), AMD ($600 PT), ARM ($320 PT), and MRVL ($270 PT) — all Overweight. INTC initiated Neutral. Compute market projected to grow 5x to $2.2T by 2030, driving ~45% EPS CAGR for compute enablers; 2027 already sold out, order books full for 2028.

bullets.title: MRVL: CEO flags societal pushback on data center builds; analyst day Oct 6 key catalyst
bullets.body: MRVL CEO Matt Murphy noted suppliers growing nervous about societal pushback to new data center construction — commentary coincided with selloff in AI infrastructure stocks. Separately, MRVL CEO raised long-term revenue outlook +$10B to $30B with datacenter segment guided to $15-16B next year; Teralynx switching expected to exceed $1B revenue. Piper rates MRVL OW into the Oct 6 analyst day.

bullets.title: TSM August revenue +53% YoY — tracking above guidance high end on AI demand
bullets.body: TSMC reported August revenue of NT$514.8B (+53% YoY, +10% MoM), tracking to the mid-to-high end of 3Q guidance. N3 supply shortage expected to worsen; margins remain mid-to-high 60% range; datacenter AI demand visibility extending to 2029-30. TSMC 1.4nm P1/P2 fabs in Taichung could begin mass production 2027, ahead of 2028 plan.

bullets.title: SHOP: JPM reiterates OW $185 PT; AI agent disintermediation risk seen as low
bullets.body: JPM reiterates SHOP Overweight at $185 PT (22x 2028E Gross Profit of $10.6B). Shares are down 13% from early September highs on AI agent concerns, but JPM argues SHOP retains payment flow via Shop Pay within Meta Muse transactions. New buyer orders from AI commerce sources occurring at ~2x the rate of traditional channels in Q2. Expects 20%+ three-year GMV/revenue/gross profit growth and ~40% operating income CAGR.

bullets.title: PINS: down 9% post-Communacopia; ad checks strong but agencies plan to cut spend
bullets.body: PINS fell 9% after CEO reiterated Q2 earnings headwinds at Communacopia (EU regulation on cross-border sellers, international restructuring). However, Piper's August ad checks flag PINS as one of the strongest performers alongside NFLX, ROKU, and YouTube. Roth QSG survey shows PINS is the only major platform where ad agencies plan to cut spend vs. add in both 2026 and 2027, as ChatGPT Ads ($1B ARR) is seen drawing dollars from PINS.

bullets.title: GOOGL: OPCO raises PT to $400 on $170B cumulative TPU opportunity through 2028
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raises GOOGL PT to $400, modeling $170B in cumulative incremental TPU sales through 2028, implying 15%/30% upside to Street GCP revenue in 2027/28. Gemini is the second most-used AI behind ChatGPT with 4x higher consumer trust than META on key metrics. Hedgeye keeps GOOGL in Bearish territory with buy/sell levels of $325/$343.

bullets.title: CMCSA: down 7% post-Communacopia on irrational fiber competition at $30-40/month for 1Gbps
bullets.body: Comcast CFO cited irrational fiber competition at $30-40 standalone pricing for 1Gbps service at the Communacopia conference, sending shares down 7%. JPM telco research confirms Comcast sees no improvement in broadband subscriber losses in Q3. The CFO commentary reinforces the structural broadband pressure narrative.

bullets.title: AVGO, AMD, ARM: Citi TMT conference highlights optical/networking as preferred semi exposure
bullets.body: At Citi's TMT conference Day 2, networking/optical semis (LITE, MRVL, COHR) gained investor favor over memory/analog/semi-cap. AMD revenue ramp cited as strong on MI450 and CPU wafer supply with 2027 seen as the stock's sweet spot. Semi-cap equipment broadly needs $215B+ WFE updates to reignite. Investors prefer discovery over flash announcements.

bullets.title: FOXA: up 4.5% after Goldman Sachs conference presentation
bullets.body: FOXA gained 4.5% in Wednesday's session following its presentation at the Goldman Sachs conference. No additional fundamental details disclosed in the items.

bullets.title: RCL, CCL flagged for technical downside; Consumer Discretionary Technical Score 2/10
bullets.body: A technical analysis note identifies RCL and CCL as weak Consumer Discretionary names with downside risk. XLY scores 2/10 technically, is below 50/200-day MAs, with risk from 114.71 to 105. 59% of Consumer Disc. stocks have Weak/Poor technical scores; only 36% are above 50-day MA. Market breadth has been negative 2/3 of the time since August 14.

bullets.title: ORCL, ADBE, RH reporting after close tonight — consensus estimates
bullets.body: Key earnings tonight: ORCL consensus $1.74 EPS / $19.13B revenue; ADBE consensus $6.08 EPS / $6.69B revenue; RH consensus $0.38 EPS / $915.4M revenue. ORCL has 11% implied move per Jefferies; ADBE options market pricing similar volatility given AI disruption concerns.

bullets.title: Hedgeye signals: AMZN downgraded to Bearish; TSLA to Neutral; MSFT, NVDA, META, SNOW remain Bullish
bullets.body: Hedgeye's Risk Range signals flip AMZN from Neutral to Bearish and TSLA from Bearish to Neutral. MSFT remains Bullish ($482 buy/$518 sell), NVDA Bullish ($216/$231), META Bullish ($591/$675), SNOW Bullish ($317/$358). GOOGL and NFLX remain Bearish. Russell 2000 (RUT) changes from Neutral to Bearish.

bullets.title: Macro: 10Y yield at 4.86%, 63% probability of Sep hike; CPI Friday is pivotal
bullets.body: US 10Y yield hit 4.86% (highest since Oct 2023) with bond market pricing ~63% probability of a 25bp hike at Sep 16 FOMC. JPM's Feroli expects Core CPI MoM +0.21%; a 0.2% rounded print supports hold while 0.3% supports hike. Brent crossed $100/bbl on US-Iran tensions (WTI $97.40). Rising yields and oil have driven negative breadth 2/3 of trading days since Aug 14, with 80%+ of S&P 500 down Wednesday.

bullets.title: AMD: Xanadu quantum collaboration (Backline) — near-term noise, not a financial catalyst
bullets.body: AMD and Xanadu Quantum Technologies announced Backline, an open-platform solution for ultra-low-latency quantum-classical computing communication built on PennyLane open-source software. This is a research/positioning initiative with no near-term revenue impact.
